events.verdict: RAR shows Bullock (DET) gives Wade (MIA) room to land on the jump shot attempt.
Griffin (DET) maintains a legal guarding position during the jump shot attempt by McGruder (MIA).
Johnson (MIA) maintains a legal guarding position during the jump shot attempt by Griffin (DET).
Adebayo (MIA) is firming up in legal position during the pick on Bullock (DET).
Pachulia (DET) cleanly dislodges the pass intended for Adebayo (MIA) without affecting his FOM.
Adebayo (MIA) slightly extends his arms into Kennard (DET) as they release from the pick.
LAR shows Kennard (DET) maintains a hand to Winslow's (MIA) side but does not extend or affect his ability to finish at the basket.

LLB shows Pachulia (DET) makes inadvertent contact with Adebayo's (MIA) face as he gathers the ball. Contact to an opponents head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Pachulia (DET) is firming up in legal position during the screen on Wade (MIA).
Winslow (MIA) makes contact to the body of Jackson (DET) on the drive that affects his SQBR.
Griffin (DET) is firming up in legal position during the pick with Wade (MIA).
Wade (MIA) wraps Griffin (DET) as they disengage from the pick.
[Observable in enhanced video] Wade (MIA) hops on the same foot after he has gathered the ball.
Jackson (DET) makes marginal contact with Wade's (MIA) arm as he gathers the ball but does not affect his ability to finish at the rim.
Pachulia (DET) is firming up in legal position during the pick on Johnson (MIA).
RLB shows Adebayo (MIA) makes contact to the arm of Griffin (DET) during his shooting motion that affects his driving shot attempt.

Johnson (MIA) makes inadvertent contact to Griffin's (DET) head going for the rebound. Contact to an opponents head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Johnson (MIA) maintains a collapsed forearm to Griffin's (DET) front during his putback that does not affect his ability to finish at the rim.
Johnson (MIA) makes incidental contact to the arm of Pachulia (DET) after the release that does not affect his play at the basket.
Adebayo (MIA) is firming up in legal position during the pick on Bullock (DET).
LLB shows Wade (MIA) makes contact with Griffin's (DET) arm that affects his ability to pass.
Griffin (DET) briefly grasps Johnson's (MIA) arm off ball but does not affect his ability to defend.
Brown (DET) cleanly dislodges the pass intended for Johnson (MIA).
Griffin (DET) briefly grasps Olynyk (MIA) as he sets the screen on Brown (DET).
Winslow (MIA) reaches in and makes contact with Jackson's (DET) arm that affects his SQBR.
Bullock (DET) is retreating and Wade (MIA) jumps forward to create the marginal contact during his jump shot attempt.
Olynyk (MIA) commits a take foul on Griffin (DET).
